item.title: Version 4.9.1
item.description: • Peek no longer gets clipped at the bottom while swinging for you in the notch

item.title: Version 4.9.0
item.description:
• A 30-second practice run on first launch: allow one, answer one, reply to one (Settings → General to replay)
  • Context meter: sessions past half full show how full, and one heads-up before a known window fills
  • Ghostty: jump straight to the session's terminal (Ghostty 1.3+)
  • Cleaner cards: less text, no "just now"

item.title: Version 4.8.1
item.description:
• Fixed: `claude -p` scripts no longer wait for a reply from the notch
  • Reply from the notch only where it can reach the session (each app's own Claude Code version is checked)
  • Cards answered in Conductor, VS Code or Claude's desktop app now close in the notch too
  • Hooks put themselves back if Claude Code or another tool removes them

item.title: Version 4.8.0
item.description:
• Reply from the notch: when Claude finishes, type your next message on the card and it carries on (Claude Code 2.1.287+)
  • Allow for this session: one click or ⌃⌥S allows the same thing until the session ends, nothing saved
  • Keyboard first: ⌃⌥1–6 picks an option, ⌃⌥R replies, ⌃⌥N shows the next waiting card, ⌃⌥O opens the terminal
  • Plan progress: sessions show "Step 2 of 5" while they work through a plan
  • Agent radar: a heads-up when two sessions edit the same file
  • Cleaner cards: Peek carries the status, so the extra dot beside the title is gone

item.title: Version 4.7.3
item.description:
• "Answer in terminal" no longer leaves the next waiting card stuck
  • Approvals stay on for Claude Code installed with nvm, volta or bun
  • "Only when blocked" sound is remembered after a restart
  • Clicking an option after typing sends just that option
  • A signed-out Claude account clears its old usage numbers
  • Long questions keep their answers
